text:
sam: quick postmortem-style sync: a customer reported a $12k gap last week where traces had no billing_key. we need a clear playbook for detection + remediation.

leah: thanks for raising. short goal: detect missing attribution quickly, remediate without double-billing, and improve early warning.

omar: detection ideas: (1) daily job that computes attributed_pct per-service; (2) realtime alert if attributed_pct drops >5% vs baseline in 1h window.

rachel: also show a per-tenant "attribution confidence" in the console. customers can see if their invoiced usage is exact or inferred.

sam: remediation path: step 0: notify service owners + billing ops; step 1: attempt best-effort lookup (service->billing_key) and mark records as "inferred"; step 2: run backfill for last 7 days if owner approves.

leah: important: inferred = not auto-billable. billing-team: confirm we can't invoice inferred records without owner sign-off.

billing-team: correct. policy: inferred can appear in UI as estimate but require manual approval for invoicing. we need audit fields for any inferred mapping (who approved, run id, confidence).

omar: technical safe-guards: (A) write inferred attributions to a separate compact table with `inference_run_id` and `confidence`, (B) keep original traces immutable, (C) provide revert api to drop a run.

infra-bot: note: last inferred run spike consumed 120 CPU-hours during backfill. consider rate-limiting.

rachel: UX: expose a "start backfill" button in service settings that creates a GOV ticket for legal/compliance if any PII is involved. default backfill window = 7d.

sam: what about sampling? if traces are sampled, we should still allow proportional attribution using hashed buckets and sample_rate metadata. include sample provenance in the compact table.

leah: yes. make sure hashed buckets are non-reversible and environment-salted. legal needs the salt recorded per run.

billing-team: add a confidence floor: only run automated backfill for mappings with confidence >= 0.75. anything below goes to manual review.

omar: draft alert thresholds: 1) realtime: attributed_pct drop >5% for >30m -> P1 page to owners; 2) daily: service attributed_pct < 90% -> create ticket; 3) inferred_fraction > 10% -> notify billing ops.

infra-bot: scheduled job INFRA-attr-monitor runs nightly at 02:30 UTC.

rachel: playbook steps for owners: triage -> check SDK/propagation lint -> run lookup tool -> if safe, kick off backfill (run_id) -> billing ops reviews -> approve for invoice. document roll-back steps.

sam: docs: add CLI tool `rk attr-lookup --service <svc> --start <ts> --end <ts>` that previews candidate attributions and shows confidence.

leah: action items: omar -> design compact inferred table schema + revert API (due Tue). rachel -> write console copy + backfill button flow (due Wed). sam -> add CLI preview tool spec (due Thu). billing-team -> define approval checklist and required audit fields (due Fri).

leah: once we have these, we'll include the playbook as an RFC appendix and run a 2-week pilot with 3 internal services. thanks everyone. :rocket:
